title: Viruses
description: Genes in a protein coat, with no life of their own: they borrow a cell's. Unlocks the Phage Lab and Bacteriophages.

puzzle.goal: p phages are mixed with c cells and land at random. Write the share F of cells hit at least once.
puzzle.name: Poisson infection
puzzle.ask: Find F for p = @{p} and c = @{c}.
puzzle.method: Each cell gets a Poisson number of hits with mean p/c; the chance of none is e^(−p/c).
